field_docs.default_preset: Preset id used when none is chosen (story 007 makes this a campaign choice)
field_docs.presets: Per preset: display_name; horde_size: whole number >= 0, zombies standing in the horde at mission start (they move only when drawn by noise or sight); roaming_count: whole number >= 0, zombies that wander the map on their own in daylight (time of day multiplies it)
